# List local drafts and published review threads.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2024-04-05T16:40:32Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
gs repo init

shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add main.go
gs bc -m 'Add main' feature1
gs branch submit --fill
stderr 'Created #'

# Root drafts are listed separately, including file-level drafts.
gs review comment main.go:4 -m 'Use a helper here.'
stderr 'Drafted comment 1'
gs review comment main.go -m 'Consider splitting this file.'
stderr 'Drafted comment 2'

# Published replies and local draft replies remain grouped with their thread.
shamhub review comment post --id 100 --author alice --path main.go --range 5:12 --side right --resolved --outdated alice/example 1 'This block is doing too much.'
stdout '100'
shamhub review comment reply --id 101 --author bob alice/example 1 thread-100 'Agreed. I would extract it.'
stdout '101'
gs review reply thread-100 -m 'I will send a follow-up.'
stderr 'Drafted reply 3'

# File-level threads do not show source excerpts.
shamhub review comment post --id 200 --author carol --path main.go alice/example 1 'The file name is too broad.'
stdout '200'

gs review list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list.txt

# Draft-only output retains the thread that owns a pending draft reply.
gs review list --draft-only
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/draft-only.txt

# A branch without a change request still reports that fact as a diagnostic.
gs bc -m 'Another branch' feature2
gs review list
stderr 'No change request'

-- repo/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	message := greeting()
	fmt.Println(message)
}

func greeting() string {
	return "hello"
}

func farewell() string {
	return "goodbye"
}
